rationale: Label::set_text skips the layout pass for a childless, non-baseline Label without a text slot of its own whose width and height are both fixed, now also when it has no captured lines (between two non-empty copies), and counts as fixed only the sizes yoga_layout() applies as numbers: a px size through preferred_*, a viewport size, or a percent fixed by every ancestor up to the root. Yoga never measures such a node and paint breaks its lines at the box width, so boxes and paint commands equal those of a tree laid out from scratch. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'fixed-box wrapping Label text repaints without a layout pass'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'intrinsic and multiline Label text still invalidates layout'
